shows.title: What it shows
items: Each topic page's **custody block** drawn **exactly as written** — your declaration of where an item or a piece of information travels. No AI interpretation in this chart, ever.

**Items** are a baton (one holder at a time — a character's gain takes it FROM the previous holder). **Information** is a contagion (knowledge spreads; AUDIENCE is a lane; the faint tints are mystery/suspense).
The purpose: **learn the audience's experience** — when the reader learns what, and how long the suspense windows run.

rows.v: Scenes + world pages first — custody is a revision-phase (2nd/3rd draft) tool that anchors to existing content.
Extraction observes possession/knowledge events. Unpaged objects appear under "From analysis".
From an analysis suggestion (drafts the Timeline from observed events — data, not AI) or the + button (anchored to an existing character/item). Free-floating topics can’t be created.
Edit the Timeline — add, correct, delete lines. The page is yours; the chart mirrors it verbatim.
Re-runs never touch your page. Analysis keeps watching and (soon) flags divergence — a character learning off-plan.

grammar.title: The grammar — three verbs, meaning from the topic kind

rows.v: item: who REPLACES the holders (one record per handoff; several who = joint possession) · information: x now KNOWS it
item with no who: destroyed/vanished · information: x forgets it (amnesia)
GLOBAL event — destruction or mass amnesia: everyone in-world loses it; the audience remembers
everyone in-world knows — the flood line
true before page one (e.g. Claudius always knew)
declares WHEN the reader learns it — without one, the AUDIENCE row falls back to the first checkpoint
v1 verbs (held-by · known-by · forgotten-by) and `since` still parse — saving rewrites them as v2

observed.title: The Observed layer — the diff, live
items: Your records are the **plan**; analysis is the **witness**. The ANALYSIS ghost lane (⟡ dashed marks) shows events analysis observed about this topic at scenes with **no declared checkpoint** — an unplanned reveal, a handoff you dated differently, or a misread to ignore.
**Silence is the success state**: when your ledger covers everything the witness saw, the lane disappears.
**Click a ghost** → the Records tab opens with the quick-add line drafted from the observed event — review it, press ⏎ to accept, or just ignore the whisper. Toggle the lane off under LAYERS.

where.title: Where it sits
items: Custody is **authored T3** — interpretation-altitude, like Coherence, but flipped: Coherence is what the **AI surfaces**; Custody is what **you declare**. The diff between them is where findings live.
